title: Automations | Ascend by Wix | Your All-in-One Business Solution
description: Automations is part of Ascend by Wix—a suite of customer management and marketing tools built into your Wix site. Find out how to create automations to work efficiently and drive more traffic to your site.  Click the link to learn more: https://www.wix.com/ascend/home  About Wix  With Wix, you can create a stunning, professional website for yourself or your clients. Choose a template or start from scratch and push the limits of web design. Add your own fonts and bring your site to life with video backgrounds, parallax scroll, retina ready image galleries, and more. Wix offers hundreds of professional features—from an online store and booking system to a beautiful blog and powerful SEO tools. Now integrated with every site is a complete business solution from Ascend by Wix that helps you connect with visitors, automate your work and grow your business.  http://www.wix.com/  https://www.facebook.com/wix  https://twitter.com/wix  https://plus.google.com/+wix/posts  http://www.pinterest.com/wixcom/  https://www.youtube.com/user/wix http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/wix.com

asr.full_text: In this video, you will learn how to create automations, to work efficiently and drive more traffic to your site. Automations is a powerful tool that can increase your site traffic up to 2.7 times, simplify your workflow, and save you time. To see how it works, go to your Site Dashboard, click Customer Management and select Automations. If it's your first time, you can create an automation and see Recommended ones from here. The recommended automations are linked to the business tools in your dashboard and add-ons from the editor. They are organized by categories according to the value they bring, like build customer relationships and engage your site members. Let's select one and see how to customize it. There are three steps in any automation. First is the trigger. This is the event which signals the automation. Here, it's when a visitor submits a form. Next, an email will be sent as the action that occurs once the automation has been triggered, then you can choose the timing of when you want it to go out, like Immediately. Click Activate and view automations to see it live in My Automations. Now let's create an automation from scratch. Click the New Automation link on the top-right of your screen. Here, you can choose which automation you want to set up. Let's create one for receiving a message in your inbox and rename it Task from inbox message. Then, select the trigger and select the action you want to respond with. Also, add the task you want to create, like sending a 10% off coupon. Then assign it to someone and set a due date for them. And select when you want it to go out. Finally, click activate to make your automation live. Click back and you can view and manage your new automation under my active automations. Slide the toggle to deactivate and reactivate it, or click the three dots to edit, rename, duplicate, or delete an automation. At the top of the page, your analytics show how many active automations you have, your total number of triggered automations, and the number of emails sent. Automations are seamlessly integrated with your ascend business tools like Forms, Chats, Workflows, and more. Start setting triggered automations to work efficiently and drive more traffic to your site. And check out more tools from Ascend by Wix- designed to help you to grow and manage your business.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a Wix Ascend tutorial showing how to create and manage website automations through ordinary dashboard steps. Its claims about increasing site traffic and helping manage a business are tied to a conventional software-feature demonstration, with no investment, credential request, prize scheme, or other scam mechanism described.
